findings.summary: Possible race if purge_job runs on a separate thread: revoke pops from _by_token before removing from _items, so purge's `del self._by_token[session.token]` can raise KeyError; use pop(token, None) or add a lock.
`self._items.remove(session)` is an O(n) scan comparing dataclasses by value; a dict keyed by token would give O(1) removal if the list is only needed for ordered listing.
